name: PU-12M lesson 5: the battery commander, in command
description: A step-by-step lesson in the battery commander's seat of the PU-12M, the battery's command post, with the lesson's guide (data/tutorials/school_pu12m_battery_commander.json) on the screen: the seat, its equipment and what each control does, then deploying the post by your order, the ASPD-U and your radios on, then a target given to a launcher with the DT-2 marker and the ДХ keys, one switch at a time, each highlighted, the next only once it is done.
notes: Fictional. The Kesmark range (as the Osa's seat lessons), the PU-12M at a halt. No crew_commander: the lesson gives the battery commander's orders (simcore/tutorial.hpp on_start) when the learner isn't him. Crew class 1. The targets' numbers are PLACEHOLDERS, held on cue. The regiment's post and its P-19 as in pu12m_deploy.json.

regiment.notes: The regiment's command post and its control battery's P-19, 8 km behind the battery: inside the R-407 net's 15 km. Its one command is ПТ-1 707 (report readiness) on the command net, held until the lesson calls for it (regiment:707).

radios.notes: The frequencies are SAM3D placeholders (a 1980s regiment's are not public): the command net on the R-111's preset 1, the post's own R-123M nets at least 10 % from it and not 8 or 16 MHz off (r111_to p. 3), the R-407's duplex pair 4 MHz apart and off its spurious channels (r407_plate).

lines.notes: The regiment's line; the lesson rings it (on_start line_call:5).

radio_data.source: rrs_1986 (radio data: frequencies by conditional number, call signs; the main station of each net); flak11 (PU12-1: the five sets' nets; FuG-2 20-27 MHz and FuG-4 37-51.5 MHz on one diplexer); bstudy_tactics (the form of call signs: a word for a station, a number for an official); every value here is a sam3d placeholder
radio_data.notes: Placeholders: a 1980s regiment's radio data are not public. Each net's working frequency is its set's preset 1, its spare preset 2. They keep the R-111's rules (r111_to p. 3): the post's own sets at least 10 % from its frequency and not 8 or 16 MHz off. The battery net and the air picture are exempt from radio silence (vst_1988: air defence and the warning system).

targets.name: Practice target (placeholder)
targets.notes: Placeholder numbers. Held until the lesson brings it in (on_cue), then a racetrack 6 to 40 km north of the post for some 40 minutes: on the IT-45 (scale M50) whenever the learner gets to it, and in the launchers' reach on its near leg.
